defects.what: The letter on the desk is covered in several lines of large pseudo-handwriting glyphs right under the quill, the centre of the shot.
The white top box on the motorcycle carries a word-like block of pseudo-letters, and the tank has a small badge; Indio is composited left of it, so the box stays visible.
A small '3' glyph sits in the phone's top-right corner and the gold coin on the screen carries a letter-like mark.
The helmet under Indio's arm has a small square badge drawn on its side.
Indio has brown, messy hair and a striped orange track jacket instead of the plain windbreaker; the topknot is barely there.
